expert_skills.skill: Understanding of how Suno generates audio in discrete segments and what spectral artifacts typically appear at generation boundaries versus within a continuous generation.
Understanding of how Suno's style and prompt conditioning affects spectral consistency across multiple generations from the same seed — and how much variance is normal versus anomalous.
Knowledge of what "reference consistency" means when the reference is itself an AI output, not a human recording, and what assumptions that transfers onto every score the tool produces.
